muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿والسماء والطارق﴾: the wāw: a particle of oath and genitive. Wa-l-samāʾ: genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath. Wa-l-ṭāriq: also sworn by, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. Mā is an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: adrā is an imperfect verb [Translator's note: so in the source; adrā is a past verb], nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, whose appearance is prevented by impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa", and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿أدراك﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ما﴾.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿الطارق﴾: khabar of the second ﴿ما﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma. The clause ﴿ما الطارق﴾ stands in place of the second and third objects of ﴿أدراك﴾. The clause ﴿وما أدراك...﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿النجم﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, i.e. "huwa al-najmu al-thāqib" (it is the piercing star); the clause is parenthetical between the oath and its answer, like the one before it. Or: a badal (substitute) from ﴿الطارق﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الثاقب﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿النجم﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إن﴾: (read) without doubling (in), a negative particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿كل﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿نفس﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿لما﴾: (read) with doubling (lammā), meaning illā, for restriction (ḥaṣr); a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿عليها﴾: ʿalā: a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn, and ﴿ها﴾: a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿حافظ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma. The nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of ﴿كل﴾, and the clause ﴿إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فلينظر﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the lām of command is a particle indeclinable on the sukūn; and yanẓur is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn.
﴿الإنسان﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿ممَّ﴾: min is a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn, and ﴿مَ﴾ is an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn on the alif, which is dropped because the preposition has entered upon it, in the position of the genitive by ﴿من﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾.
﴿خلق﴾: a passive past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa". The clause ﴿خلق﴾ is in the place of the accusative by His saying ﴿فلينظر﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from it by the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿خلق﴾: a passive past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿ماء﴾: a noun in the genitive by min, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾.
﴿دافق﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ماء﴾, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the kasra. The clause ﴿خلق...﴾ is resumptive by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position, or a badal (substitute) from ﴿خلق﴾ in the previous ayah.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿يخرج﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa".
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿بين﴾: an adverb, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿الصلب﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿والترائب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and al-tarāʾib is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to al-ṣulb, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle for emphasis and the accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the pronoun is indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of inna, referring to Allah.
﴿على﴾: a preposition indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿رجعه﴾: a noun in the genitive by ﴿على﴾, the sign of the genitive being the kasra, and the pronoun is indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادر﴾.
﴿لقادر﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) is a particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ﴿قادر﴾ is khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قادر﴾.
﴿تبلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma.
﴿السرائر﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma. The clause ﴿تبلى السرائر﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's annexation to it.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and mā is negative, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿له﴾: the lām is a preposition indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the pronoun is indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿من﴾: a connective (ṣila) preposition indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿قوة﴾: a noun genitive by min in form and nominative by position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable on the fatḥa, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative, a particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿ناصر﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿قوة﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿والسماء﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and al-samāʾ: a noun in the genitive by the wāw of the oath, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath.
﴿ذات﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿السماء﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿الرجع﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿السماء﴾.
﴿ذات﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿الصدع﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle for emphasis and the accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the pronoun is indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of inna.
﴿لقول﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) is a particle indeclinable on the fatḥa, and it is for emphasis; ﴿قول﴾ is khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿فصل﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قول﴾. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative mā, which works like laysa; it is a negative particle indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿هو﴾: a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the noun (ism) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿بالهزل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿الهزل﴾ is the predicate (khabar) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by position and genitive by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿إنهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; inna is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle for emphasis and the accusative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of ﴿إن﴾; and the mīm is a particle of the plural, indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿يكيدون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). The clause yakīdūn is khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿كيدًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وأكيد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and ﴿أكيد﴾ is an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يكيدون﴾, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿كيدا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فمهل﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (signalling an implied condition), a particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and mahhil is an imperative verb indeclinable on the sukūn; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta".
﴿الكافرين﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿أمهلهم﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable on the sukūn; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta"; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; and the mīm is a particle of the plural, indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿رويدًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) from an unused verb, synonymous with its governing word; it is the diminutive of ﴿إرْواد﴾ by way of truncation (tarkhīm), and it is accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
